# edgeglint

> First-party web analytics on Cloudflare Workers and Analytics Engine, without measurement cookies or visitor identifiers.

The country-code rule decreases coverage. No unique visitors or session replay. No consent exemption or license grant is promised.


## Documentation

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/README.md): Setup and verification.
- [Agent procedure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/AGENTS.md): Shared installation steps.
- [Technical decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/docs/research.md): Dated research and legal limits.
- [Measurement levels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/docs/tiers.md): Current features and proposals.
- [Data flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/docs/data-flow.md): Fields, logs, retention and notice template.
- [Framework recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dataxad/edgeglint/main/docs/install.md): Source adapters.
- [Adapters](https://github.com/dataxad/edgeglint/blob/main/src/adapters.js): Astro and Pages request handlers.
- [Project page](https://dataxad.com/projects/edgeglint): Project overview.
